description.value: Vogue Cafe is a French-brunch restaurant located in the Steveston district of Richmond, BC — a historic fishing village popular with cyclists riding the dyke trails of the Lower Mainland. The cafe offers full dine-in service with a bar alongside takeout and delivery, and its French-inflected brunch menu sets it apart from the seafood-focused establishments that dominate the Steveston waterfront.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: loops (12 spaces) at 52m; rack at 59m; rack at 66m; rack at 78m; rack at 88m. Total: 12 spaces.
